about: Gair, Gair, Conason, Rubinowitz, Bloom, Hershenhorn, Steigman & Mackauf is a personal injury firm working from a single office in Manhattan.
The firm states that personal injury cases are often handled on a contingent fee basis and that there is no charge for the initial consultation. It publishes material in English and Spanish.
